desc: Perform small-instance exhaustive classification of reachable states for Dyck strings of semilength at most 4, recording tree/forest structure and candidate invariants.
Determine precisely how the operation acts on rooted forests and ordered trees.
Derive a complete, duplicate-free characterization of reachable strings from the observed invariant.
Develop an \(O(N^2)\)-compatible DP for counting distinct reachable strings.
Verify the recurrence on edge cases and both samples.
Implement the algorithm in Python with modular arithmetic and \(N\le 5000\) resource limits.
